title: Curate launch annotation digest and stakeholder review path
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a consolidated, annotated launch digest and stakeholder review path that feeds both internal comms (exec TL;DR, engineering changelog, support playbook) and customer-facing changelogs (tiered summaries and in-product snippets). Deliverables: 1) master Confluence digest with line-item annotations per change (impact, migration notes, breaking vs non-breaking), 2) segmented copy drafts for execs, technical integrators, and end-users, 3) embargo calendar and sign-off matrix (product, eng, design, legal, security, support), 4) customer-facing snippets for the API changelog and dashboard banner, 5) localized translations plan and redaction pipeline for PII/Sensitive content.
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff completed. Agreed scope with Design (Eve Park) to supply in-product banner comps and with Eng (Ravi Patel) on exact API change wording. Set canonical Confluence page and Drive asset folder.

2026-03-03: Drafted annotated digest outline with categories (Behavioral, Config, Performance, Security). Decision: include example curl snippets for all API changes. Trade-off noted: adding samples increases translation effort (see localization task).

2026-03-04: Legal (Priya Desai) reviewed initial draft. Two items flagged for redaction: KMS integration details and internal SLA numbers. Action: create redaction checklist and route through security team by 2026-03-06.

2026-03-06: Security review completed for non-sensitive sections. Blocker: one internal telemetry metric name requires obfuscation before customer release. Assigned ENG-1973 to remediate and update sample payloads.

2026-03-07: Design provided banner copy and localization constraints. Decided on three-tier customer messaging: Executive (1-2 sentences), Integrator (concise changes + migration notes), End-user (what changed & how it affects usage).
2026-03-08: Prepared customer snippet set and applied redaction. Open PR created for docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Requested reviews from docs, eng, legal.
2026-03-09: Support playbook draft added to Confluence with sample Q&A and rollback guidance. Noted dependency on release pipeline tagging (ENG-2052).

2026-03-10: Consolidated reviewer feedback. Engineering asked to soften language around latency improvements to avoid SLA implications; Marketing requested a quote for the exec brief. Readying final sign-offs for 2026-03-12.
Open action items: finalize translations for EN->FR/DE/JA, confirm banner scheduling windows with infra (region staging), merge docs PR after legal redaction verification.
comments: Eve Park (Design) 2026-03-02: Banner comps attached; keep the hero copy <70 chars. Will provide alt copy for space-constrained regions.
Ravi Patel (Eng) 2026-03-03: API change is backward compatible; recommend adding an example showing legacy vs new behavior. I'll add the snippet to the PR.
Priya Desai (Legal) 2026-03-04: Please remove explicit KMS key identifiers and SLA percentile figures. We can refer to 'configured customer SLAs' instead. I'll re-review after redaction.
Samir Khan (Support) 2026-03-06: Added two likely customer questions to the support playbook. Need confirmation from Eng on expected error codes.

Elena Morales (Marketing) 2026-03-09: Exec one-liner suggestion: 'Reduced inference cost per token and improved latency for medium-length contexts' — needs quant justification from Benchmarks dashboard.
Marco Ruiz (PM) 2026-03-10: Merging all feedback today. Note: if ENG-1973 is not addressed by 2026-03-11, we will roll with a more generic public note and add technical appendices post-launch.
output_snippets: EXEC-TLDR: Lower per-token inference cost and targeted latency improvements for medium-length contexts; no breaking API changes. See console-2026.03 release notes for migration notes.
INTEGRATOR-NOTE: The /v1/generate endpoint returns identical schema; new optional 'response_mode' flag enables lower-latency decoding paths. If you pass response_mode=compat, behavior is unchanged.
ENDUSER: Model responses are faster in many cases and may slightly change phrasing for long prompts. No action required unless you rely on sub-token timing for instrumentation.
localization_plan: Priority locales: FR, DE, JA. Use in-house translations for exec blurbs and vendor for long-form changelog items.
Cutoff for translation: 2026-03-11 18:00 UTC to meet 2026-03-15 release date.
QA: small-sample review by native speakers in Product before publish.
rollout_and_communication: Embargo window: 2026-03-12 09:00 - 2026-03-12 17:00 UTC for internal sign-offs.
Publish plan: staged publish to customers in three waves (Beta testers, High-touch accounts, All customers) over 48 hours.
Channels: Docs site, Console banner, Developer newsletter, Support digest, Sales enablement pack.
post_launch_metrics: Doc visits: target 5k views first week
Support signal: <3% traffic increase to support for related topics
Performance regression alerts: none or immediate rollback per runtime-1.20 canary gating
